property_summary: In the reference C, settle() resets the player's guess block to 0, so after settling, the same address can lock in a new guess; the mutant never resets it, so the follow-up lockInGuess always reverts.
change_summary: Remove the reset of guesses[msg.sender].block to 0 so that settle can be called repeatedly (including repeatedly paying a winner, and preventing lockInGuess in a way differing from P).
